title: chore: configure Dependabot dependency updates
body:
## Summary

Adds `.github/dependabot.yml` to enable automated dependency updates for:

- **pip**: weekly on Monday at 09:00 Europe/Paris, grouped minor and patch updates
- **github-actions**: weekly on Monday at 10:00 Europe/Paris, grouped minor and patch updates

All updates are assigned to `glandais`, labeled `dependencies`, and use scoped commit prefixes.
